<function name="LocalEyeAngles" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns the direction a player is looking as a entity/local-oriented angle.

Unlike <page>Entity:EyeAngles</page>, this function does not include angles of the Player's <page>Entity:GetParent</page>.

<bug>Does not work correctly clientside for non local players when in a vehicle. (validate: when parented in general?)</bug>
	</description>
	<added>2021.06.09</added>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Angle">The local eye angles.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
